seoTitle: Long Weekend and Bridge Day Finder from Your Holiday List
metaDescription: Paste your holidays and find long weekends and the leave days that bridge a holiday to a weekend. Free, offline.
intro: Finds runs of three or more days off created by your holidays and weekends, and shows which one or two leave days would join them.
why:
Planning leave around holidays means looking for a Thursday holiday and taking Friday. Paste your own list of public holidays and this does the search.

It does not know any country's holidays, since that needs an up-to-date source, so you supply the dates. Substitute days are not added.
howTo: Paste holidays as YYYY-MM-DD with an optional name.
Choose your weekend days and how many leave days you will bridge.
Read the long weekends and bridge options.

faq.q: Where do I get holiday dates?
faq.a: From your government or employer calendar. The tool does not fetch them.
Yes, any years in the list.
Choose Friday and Saturday for countries that use it.
